title: Famous visitors sitting in at Nick's
summary: Talk of Larry Shields and the Dorseys sitting in at Nick's.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: In those days I was traveling around the country a lot. I was in the Depression and every time I'd come back to town, my friend would say, Steve Smith, say, you should have been here last week. Larry Shields sat in with the band. Yeah, yes. I never did get to hear Larry. Never in my life. He never? Only on record.
Oh, he played wonderful, wonderful. Well, in fact, Tommy Dorsey, Jimmy Dorsey, all of them came down and they'd sit in. We'd had a ball in that place.
